analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, deletions, patches and CI surrounding source. The removed executable hooks only checked console-ui: .githooks/pre-commit base:16–27 ran ESLint; .githooks/pre-push base:35–55 ran console lint/build. Deleting .github/dependabot.yml removes the npm configuration scoped solely to /console-ui (base:3–4), including security-update grouping (base:20–28). CI removes the corresponding routing lane (base:37) and console dependency installation, lint, tests and build (base:638–658).
The complete supplied CI patch leaves provider release-integrity checks, advisory threat-review tests, native safety/cache/media tests, parity lanes, provider-test-gate and Swift cache behavior unchanged. These changes do not directly alter provider authorization/attestation (T-052–T-058), encryption and plaintext handling (T-008, T-011, T-014, T-050), cache isolation/storage (T-041), inference availability, or privileged-helper/local-hold boundaries. No concrete exploit or provider threat-model mitigation removal is established; generic lint/build removal alone is not proof of a security vulnerability.
Integration should reconcile these four tooling removals with the PR's console source/ownership changes: whether console-ui is retired here or remains a maintained artifact losing dependency-security automation and tests. That source is absent from this batch, and the canonical scope excludes consumer/admin console implementation. This is a coverage question, not evidence of unsafe deployment or missing replacement controls. Only indexed and selected threat definitions were supplied; this is not a full audit.
